questions.text: T-2 and T-8 accept unbounded count scans (awaitingOutcome has no lower bound, and the list total is unpaged) with no new control. Do you accept these performance risks for HMS-21, or should implement add a status/starts_at index?

rubric_items.reason: All nine design components (CO-1 to CO-9) have at least one threat, under the same names the design uses. EP-1 and EP-2 are covered through their components.
Each threat fits its component: injection through the new bound, a client-supplied instant, the payload shape, unbounded scans, URL tampering. T-9 and T-13 are now filed as contract tampering.
Most mitigations cite code that checks out, or name a clear new control for implement. T-3 cites C12 (the DSH-9 comment) as proof of the exact-match totals test, but C12 does not show that test.

T-2, T-5, T-8 and T-14 are stated openly as accepted risks, each with its basis. The DoS acceptances in T-2 and T-8 are made by the skill alone; questions is empty, so no human was asked to accept them.
Short and readable. Threats are ordered by risk, and the Known list matches the mitigation labels.
